volt-pink.$description: Volt Pink — Primary action buttons, section labels, active states, cookie accept — the sole chromatic brand color, carrying 100% of the accent weight in the interface

obsidian.$description: Obsidian — Page text, floating navigation bar, bold display headlines, cookie banner surface, icon fills

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Page canvas, section backgrounds, text on dark surfaces, card surfaces in light sections

ash.$description: Ash — Hairline borders, card inset rings, subtle dividers, secondary text on light backgrounds

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Input borders, secondary surface fills, muted UI elements

onyx.$description: Onyx — Secondary button backgrounds, elevated surface tone

mist.$description: Mist — Input field backgrounds, subtle fill surfaces

sans-serif.$description: sans-serif — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

polysans-bulky.$description: Hero display headlines — the signature compressed ultra-bold weight; tight line-height (1.0) lets the letters stack like a logo mark rather than reading as paragraphs

polysans-median.$description: Primary workhorse — nav links, section headings, the 86px display for page-openers, all-caps micro-labels with 0.05em tracking. The compressed line-heights (0.85–1.0) at large sizes are what give Wizz its editorial-magazine density

polysans-neutral.$description: Body copy, paragraph text, descriptive content — generous line-height (1.5) creates reading rhythm distinct from the tight display set

polysans-slim.$description: Light-weight utility text, subtle links, fine-print detail — provides typographic contrast against heavier Median weights in the same layout

inter.$description: Inter — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
